_comment: Merchant rules for scripts/classify.py. First match wins (top to bottom). Patterns are case-insensitive substrings of the Amex merchant text. tag: business|personal|needs-tag or null (no tag opinion, kontering only; card default decides). entity: viseo|5555media. vat_regime vocabulary (consumed by fortnox_lane.py): domestic25, domestic12, domestic6, domestic25_half, eu_rc, noneu_rc, oss_pending, none. Kontering per the 2026-08-24 proposal, pending Nicolina's one-time review.
